capabilities: generate tags for notes with a local Ollama model
restrict tagging to a custom tag list
exclude files or folders via patterns
extras: Requires Ollama installed and running locally or on an accessible server; supports a custom Ollama server URL for remote setups.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to tag existing notes automatically; doing it by hand across many notes is slow.

relations.evidence: This plugin uses Ollama to automatically tag your Obsidian notes using large language models running locally

summary: AI tagging plugin that generates tags and brief summaries for notes using local LLMs served through Ollama.
